name: KCRW Presents: Moon Panda
description: KCRW Presents: Moon Panda [December 2, 2026 / Doors 6:30pm / $15 adv / $18 dos / All Ages] There?s a strange comfort in knowing someone you love is out there somewhere, under the same sky. Moon Panda make music for that kind of feeling - dreamy, intimate and a little otherworldly, with warm grooves, hazy guitars and strange little synth sounds floating somewhere between the 70s and whatever decade we?re heading into. There?s always been a gentle push and pull to their world: drowsy but bright-eyed, nostalgic but never quite looking backwards, soft around the edges while occasionally saying something rather sharp. At its heart, Moon Panda is music about feeling close - to another person, to a place, or to some half-remembered version of yourself.

name: BEAT: Belew/Vai/Levin/Bozzio Performing the Music of KING CRIMSON
description: Following more than 100 acclaimed performances across North and South America, Europe, and Japan, BEAT returns this fall for the last North American tour. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by guitar virtuoso Steve Vai and legendary drummer Terry Bozzio to perform the music of the three landmark 1980s King Crimson albums Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair. Rather than attempting to recreate the original recordings, BEAT brings this extraordinary music to life with the spirit, precision, and adventurousness that made it so enduring. Whether you've lived with these albums for decades or are discovering them for the first time, this is the final opportunity to experience one of progressive music's most celebrated catalogs performed by four of the best musicians on the planet.

name: Devkota: Recovery Nights
description: The Moroccan Lounge Presents: Devkota: Recovery Nights with support from David Lee [December 2, 2026 / Doors 9:30pm / $15 adv / $18 dos / All Ages] Twenty-one-year-old R&B singer Devkota went from singing for strangers outside a mall to more than 52 million streams in under two years. Born in Nepal and raised in Orange County, California from age 15, he grew up on Michael Jackson and Prince before The Weeknd showed him where modern R&B could go. His breakout single "Figure You Out" hit #1 on Spotify's Viral 50 UK, #4 on Viral 50 Global and #3 in Belgium. It peaked at 500K daily streams and broke into Shazam's US chart, earning a co-sign from Swae Lee along the way. With just a handful of songs he's built an audience of 2.1 million monthly listeners.
